meta.name: adversarial-reviewer
meta.description: Adversarial code review that breaks the self-review monoculture. Use when you want a genuinely critical review of recent changes, before merging a PR, or when you suspect Claude is being too agreeable about code quality. Forces perspective shifts through hostile reviewer personas that catch blind spots the author's mental model shares with the reviewer.

counter.description: 静态文本估算: CJK 字符 + 拉丁词 + 符号混合计数;不代表任一模型真实 tokenizer。单文本文件 >256KB 或 symlink 逃逸包外的不计入。

copy.tagline: 在合并前获得真正挑剔的代码审查
copy.fit_line: 适合你，如果希望代码审查能发现盲点，避免自我审查的盲区
copy.tagline_en: Get genuinely critical code reviews before merging
copy.fit_line_en: For you if you want code reviews that catch blind spots and avoid self-review bias

howto.what: 装上这个技能后,Claude会以三个敌对人设(破坏者、新人、安全审计员)来审查代码改动。每个人设必须至少找出一个问题,不能只说“看起来没问题”。最后会按严重程度分类,并给出“阻止合并、有顾虑、干净”的结论。
howto.when: 当你想真正批判性地审查最近改动、在合并PR前,或怀疑Claude对代码质量过于顺从时触发;也适用于长时间编码后、安全敏感代码等场景。

say.text: 请用对抗性审查模式审一下我刚写的代码,别留情面。
say.note: 会启动三个敌对人设进行审查。

say.text: 对我这次提交做一次对抗性审查,给出结论。
say.note: 会输出带结论的审查报告。

say.text: 用安全审计员视角检查 src/auth.ts 文件。

howto.what_en: With this skill, Claude reviews code changes through three adversarial personas: Saboteur, New Hire, and Security Auditor. Each persona must find at least one issue — no 'LGTM' escapes. Findings are severity-classified, and a BLOCK/CONCERNS/CLEAN verdict is given.
howto.when_en: Triggered by requests for critical review of recent changes, pre-merge PR checks, or suspicion of overly agreeable reviews. Also after long sessions or on security-sensitive code.

say_en.text: Review my recent code changes adversarially; don't hold back.
Run an adversarial review on this commit and give a verdict.
Inspect src/auth.ts from a security auditor's perspective.
